`pending` - The email address is valid, but the subscription is pending double opt-in.
`active` - The email was valid and the subscription is active.
`inactive` - The subscription was made inactive, possibly due to an unsubscribe.
`needs_attention` - The subscription requires approval or denial.
`paused` - The subscriber has paused their subscription.

created.description: The date the subscription was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch

subscription_tier.description: The current tier of the subscription.

subscription_premium_tier_names.description: The current premium tiers of the subscription. Empty if the subscriber is not associated with any premium tiers.

utm_source.description: The acquisition source; where the subscriber came from

utm_medium.description: The acquisition medium; how the subscriber got to your publication

utm_term.description: The acquisition term; typically the keyword or search term

utm_content.description: The acquisition content; typically used for A/B testing or ad variations

referring_site.description: The website that the subscriber was referred from

referral_code.description: The code associated to this subscriber to refer others. When a new subscription is created with this referral code, credit for the referral goes to this subscription.

subscription_premium_tiers.description: Optional list of tiers for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [subscription_premium_tiers]` in the request body.

id.description: The prefixed ID of the tier.

status.description: Returns whether or not the tier has any active prices.

custom_fields.description: Optional list of custom fields for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [custom_field]` in the request body.

name.description: The name of the existing custom field

kind.description: The type of value being stored in the custom field.

tags.description:
Optional list of tags for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [tags]` in the request body.
Max limit of 100 unique tags per publication.

stats.description: Optional list of stats for a subscription. Retrievable by including `expand: [stats]` in the request body.

emails_received.description: The total number of emails that have been sent to this subscriber

open_rate.description: The percentage of emails that the subscriber has opened

click_through_rate.description: The percentage of emails that the subscriber has clicked a link in
